Copied unmodified from Amy's scifi-ui library on 2026-09-19, at commit
43857a2 (2026-09-15):

  https://github.com/amyleesterling/scifi-ui

  hologram.css        the main set: the holoframe with its HUD corner
                      brackets, the panel and readout surfaces, tokens at
                      the top (site.css redefines the tokens for this
                      site's palette; the file itself is untouched)
  hologram-tap.js     the tap layer that puts .holo-on on anything with a
                      hover treatment, so the brackets are reachable on a
                      screen with no pointer. The library's rule: load it
                      on any page that loads any part of the library.
  panel-surface.css   .holopanel, the dark gradient panel with the lit top
                      hairline and the materialise entrance (is-in)

Consumers: only the generated sci-fi pages (scifi.html loads all three;
scifi-civ.html loads hologram.css and panel-surface.css). The default
pages, index.html and civ.html (the atlas, ink on paper), load no part of
the library. On the sci-fi pages the polity card (#tip) is built on
.holopanel and .holoframe, carries the frame's four HUD brackets and
plays the materialise each time it opens (js/app.js replays is-in); the
map key, the notice, the hint, the search panel and the card page's
hero, ending and period boxes are .holopanel surfaces; the brand is a
.holounder. site.css redefines the tokens for this palette, with no warm
accent at all: Amy's rule is no orange anywhere. The library's converge
swarm was used on the card from 2026-09-20 and removed the same day:
Amy found the particles distracting and meant the box itself to
materialise.

Do not edit these files. To upgrade, copy the same three down from a
newer commit and update the commit above. Licence: see the repository.
